### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /search — 1cr

Searches TripAdvisor for businesses and places (restaurants, hotels, attractions) matching a keyword in a location. Returns a unified PlaceList: each result carries the place name, category, star rating, total review count, and the `url_path` (the `id`/`url` are derived from it) that you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/reviews to pull that place's reviews. Results are location-bound (default: United States). Read from a task-based upstream; the async lifecycle is handled server-side, so this is an ordinary synchronous request (first calls take ~15-45s, then serve from cache).

**Parameters**

- `q`: Business category, company name, or prominent place (e.g. 'pizza restaurant').
- `location` *(optional)*: Full location name (e.g. 'New York,New York,United States'). Default: United States. Results are location-bound.
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional language code to narrow results, e.g. 'en'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of results to retrieve (multiples of 30, default 30, max 60 on this synchronous endpoint).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/search?q=<q>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews — 1-5cr

Returns a unified ReviewList of traveler reviews for a TripAdvisor place, keyed by its `url_path` (`entity_id` on every review). Each review carries the star rating, full text, title, reviewer profile, attached photos, owner/management `responses[]`, the original + translated language (TripAdvisor auto-translates: a `translated` flag marks it), and publish date. Get the `url_path` from /v1/tripadvisor/search. Filter by traveler rating, traveler type, or a keyword. The synchronous endpoint caps `depth` at 30 (deeper history is a future async surface); a place with no matching reviews returns 404 (auto-refunded). Read from a task-based upstream (first calls ~15-45s, then cached).

> ⚠️ **Metered: 1-5 credits a call — budget the 5 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 1-5 (metered): 1 credit per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.

**Parameters**

- `url_path`: The TripAdvisor `url_path` of the place (from a search result), e.g. 'Hotel_Review-g60763-d23462501-Reviews-Margaritaville_Times_Square-New_York_City_New_York.html'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of reviews to retrieve (multiples of 10, default 10, max 30 on this synchronous endpoint).
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Review ordering: `most_recent` or `detailed_reviews`.
- `rating` *(optional)*: Filter by traveler rating bucket: excellent | very_good | average | poor | terrible.
- `visit_type` *(optional)*: Filter by traveler type: families | couples | solo | business | friends.
- `search_reviews_keyword` *(optional)*: Only return reviews containing this keyword.
- `translate` *(optional)*: Translate reviews to the place's domain language (default true). The `translated` flag + `original_language` are always returned.
- `label` *(optional)*: Optional CSV of SocialCrawl labels to add to every review. Without this param every page already carries sentiment and issue, free; label= adds the labels you name to them (the defaults keep running). sentiment and issue are free when asked for too; reports, incentivized and injection add 1 credit per started 25 newly judged reviews. judgments=off (or label=none) turns the default labels off. They read the review's title and text, never its stars. sentiment: how the reviewer feels, on five levels (level 0 to 4, score_0_1, confidence), plus rating_mismatch, true when the words clearly contradict the star rating (a glowing text under 1 star, a furious one under 5), null when the review has no rating. issue: the main problem the review reports (label: product_defect, sizing_or_fit, shipping_or_delivery, customer_service, price_or_value, missing_feature, other, or none, with confidence; label is null when unsure). reports (needs reports=): does this review say that the thing you describe happened (p, 0 to 1). incentivized: does the reviewer say they got the product free, discounted or rewarded for the review (p), and did the text carry a disclosure such as 'in exchange for my honest review', Vine or 체험단 (disclosed). injection flags text that addresses an AI system and tries to direct it (flagged, p); it never drops or rewrites a row. These are signals to read, never a verdict on a review or a reviewer. A review that could not be judged carries labels: null. Reviews already labelled for anyone are free, and so is a cached page. data.labels reports what was judged and billed.
- `reports` *(optional)*: Required by label=reports, ignored otherwise. What to look for, in plain words, up to 300 characters, for example reports=the battery drains quickly or reports=배송이 늦음. Every review gains labels.reports.p, the probability that it says so, in any wording or language. Without it label=reports is skipped with the warning label_reports_needs_reports and is not billed.
- `judgments` *(optional)*: Optional, on (the default) or off. By default every row gains free SocialCrawl judgments (computed.labels, and computed.relevance on search endpoints), reported in data.labels (mode default) and data.relevance (origin default), each with a status (complete, partial or skipped) and pending: the rows still being judged when the page was sent, which carry null now and are filled on your next call or cached read. Default judgments never add credits, never change an existing field, and never drop or reorder a row. off returns the page exactly as before, with none of those keys. label=none does the same.
- `dry_run` *(optional)*: Optional. When 1, return a cost preview for this labelled or relevance-filtered request without fetching the page or judging any row. data.estimate reports rows_expected, rows_cached, label_credits_min, label_credits_max and base_credits. 0 credits charged.
- `label_evidence` *(optional)*: Optional, only with label=. When 1, every labelled row also carries computed.labels_evidence.<preset> = { quote, sentence_index }: the sentence in the row that most clearly shows the label, copied verbatim. Absent or null when no single sentence shows it.
- `fit` *(optional)*: Optional. When goal, keep the rows and fields needed for the goal you pass in goal= (plus any that are uncertain, and the first and last), and replace the rest with a stub. data.held_back lists the held ids and a recall id that re-reads the full page from cache at no extra charge. Without this param the page is unchanged.
- `goal` *(optional)*: Required by fit=goal. What you are trying to do, in your own words, up to 300 characters.
- `fit_tokens` *(optional)*: Optional, only with fit=goal. Soft cap on how much of the page to keep, in tokens. Uncertain blocks and the first and last block are kept even if they exceed it.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/reviews?url_path=<url_path>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /place — 1cr

Resolves any TripAdvisor place URL - hotel, restaurant, or attraction - into a unified Place: name, category, star rating, total review count, price level, address, phone, coordinates, and images. This is the generic resolver: pass the `url_path` from a /v1/tripadvisor/search result, or any TripAdvisor page URL a user pasted, and get back the resolved place. Use it to confirm which property a `url_path` actually points at before pulling its reviews, because TripAdvisor keys on the numeric id in the path and ignores the slug text, so a stale slug can name a different property than the one it resolves to. A URL that resolves to nothing returns 404 (auto-refunded).

**Parameters**

- `url_path`: The TripAdvisor `url_path` of the place (from a search result), or a full TripAdvisor page URL.
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale for the response, e.g. 'en_US'.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code for price fields, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/place?url_path=<url_path>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /autocomplete — 1cr

Type-ahead lookup for TripAdvisor destinations, hotels, restaurants, and attractions. Returns a unified PlaceList with the resolved location id, name, locality subtitle (e.g. 'Ile-de-France, France'), coordinates, thumbnail, and the TripAdvisor URL to chain into /v1/tripadvisor/place or /v1/tripadvisor/reviews. Best for turning a name a user typed into a concrete place. Note this lane carries NO star rating and NO review count - use /v1/tripadvisor/search when you need those on every result.

**Parameters**

- `q`: Destination, place, hotel, restaurant, or attraction name, e.g. 'Paris'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of suggestions to return (default 10, max 50).
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale, e.g. 'en-US'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/autocomplete?q=<q>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /hotels — 1cr

Searches TripAdvisor hotels in a destination, with filters for nightly price band, hotel class, guest rating, and property type. Returns a unified PlaceList: name, category, and the `url_path` you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/hotel or /v1/tripadvisor/reviews. Note this lane returns no star rating and no review count per result - chain /v1/tripadvisor/hotel for those, or use /v1/tripadvisor/restaurants and /v1/tripadvisor/attractions, whose results do carry ratings.

**Parameters**

- `q`: City, region, or destination, e.g. 'Paris'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of hotels to retrieve (default 30, max 100).
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Ordering: BEST_VALUE | RANKED | PRICE_LOW_TO_HIGH | DISTANCE.
- `price_min` *(optional)*: Minimum nightly price. Omit for no minimum.
- `price_max` *(optional)*: Maximum nightly price. Omit for no maximum.
- `star_rating_min` *(optional)*: Minimum hotel class: any | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5.
- `review_score_min` *(optional)*: Minimum guest rating: any | 3 | 3.5 | 4 | 4.5 | 5.
- `property_type` *(optional)*: Property type: any | hotel | resort | apartment | villa | hostel | guest_house | bed_and_breakfast.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/hotels?q=<q>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /hotel — 1cr

Returns a unified Place for one TripAdvisor hotel: name, star rating, total review count, price band, address, phone, coordinates, its rank within the destination, and its amenity list. Get the `url_path` from /v1/tripadvisor/hotels or /v1/tripadvisor/search. A `url_path` matching no property returns 404 (auto-refunded).

**Parameters**

- `url_path`: The TripAdvisor `url_path` of the hotel, or a full TripAdvisor hotel URL.
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale for the response, e.g. 'en_US'.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code for price fields, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/hotel?url_path=<url_path>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /restaurants — 1cr

Searches TripAdvisor restaurants in a destination, with filters for cuisine, meal type, price level, dietary restriction, open-now, and online reservations. Returns a unified PlaceList carrying the star rating, review count, cuisine tags, a photo, and the `url_path` you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/restaurant or /v1/tripadvisor/restaurant/reviews.

**Parameters**

- `q`: City, region, or destination, e.g. 'Paris'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of restaurants to retrieve (default 30, max 100).
- `cuisine` *(optional)*: Cuisine filter: any | local | italian | french | indian | chinese | japanese | mexican | seafood | steakhouse | cafe | fast_food.
- `meal_type` *(optional)*: Meal filter: any | breakfast | lunch | dinner | brunch.
- `price_level` *(optional)*: Price band: any | cheap | moderate | expensive | fine_dining.
- `dietary_restriction` *(optional)*: Dietary filter: any | vegetarian | vegan | gluten_free | halal | kosher.
- `open_now` *(optional)*: Only return restaurants currently marked open.
- `online_reservations` *(optional)*: Only return restaurants that accept online reservations.
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale, e.g. 'en-US'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/restaurants?q=<q>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /restaurant — 1cr

Returns a unified Place for one TripAdvisor restaurant: name, star rating, total review count, price band, cuisine tags, full address, phone, coordinates, opening hours by day, its rank within the destination, and whether the listing is claimed by its owner. Get the `url_path` from /v1/tripadvisor/restaurants or /v1/tripadvisor/search.

**Parameters**

- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale for the response, e.g. 'en_US'.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code for price fields, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash

  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /attractions — 1cr

Searches TripAdvisor attractions, tours, museums, and activities in a destination, with filters for category, duration, minimum traveler rating, free cancellation, skip-the-line, and private tours. Returns a unified PlaceList carrying the star rating, review count, a photo, and the `url_path` you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/attraction or /v1/tripadvisor/attraction/reviews.

**Parameters**

- `q`: City, region, or destination, e.g. 'Bangkok'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of attractions to retrieve (default 30, max 100).
- `category` *(optional)*: Category: any | attractions | tours | outdoor_activities | museums | shopping | nightlife | spas | classes_workshops.
- `duration` *(optional)*: Activity duration: any | lt_1_hour | 1_to_4_hours | 4_hours_to_1_day | multi_day.
- `traveler_rating` *(optional)*: Minimum traveler rating: any | 3 | 3.5 | 4 | 4.5 | 5.
- `free_cancellation` *(optional)*: Only return activities with free cancellation.
- `skip_the_line` *(optional)*: Only return skip-the-line activities.
- `private_tour` *(optional)*: Only return private tours.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/attractions?q=<q>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /experience-types — 1cr

Returns the activity taxonomy TripAdvisor uses for a destination, with the number of bookable experiences in each type (for example 'Full-day Tours' 915) and a deep link to that filtered listing. Use it to size a destination's activity market before pulling /v1/tripadvisor/attractions, or to drive a category picker.

**Parameters**

- `query`: City, region, or destination, e.g. 'Bangkok'.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/experience-types?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /cruises — 1cr

Searches TripAdvisor cruise sailings for a destination, with filters for departure month, cabin type, and trip length. Returns a unified PlaceList: each sailing carries the ship name, its rating and review count, the departure port, and the `url_path` you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/cruise or /v1/tripadvisor/cruise/reviews.

**Parameters**

- `q`: Cruise destination, e.g. 'Caribbean'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of sailings to retrieve (default 20, max 100).
- `departure_month` *(optional)*: Departure month in YYYY-MM format, e.g. '2026-07'.
- `cabin_type` *(optional)*: Cabin type: any | inside | oceanview | balcony | suite.
- `length` *(optional)*: Trip length in nights: any | 1-2 | 3-5 | 6-9 | 10-14 | 15+.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code, e.g. 'USD'.
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale, e.g. 'en_US'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/cruises?q=<q>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /cruise — 1cr

Returns a unified Place for one TripAdvisor cruise ship: name, description, passenger rating, total review count, and its photo gallery. Get the `url_path` from a /v1/tripadvisor/cruises result. Note a ship has no address, phone or price band, so those leaves are null by design.

**Parameters**

- `url_path`: The TripAdvisor cruise `url_path`, or a full TripAdvisor cruise URL.
- `language` *(optional)*: Optional locale for the response, e.g. 'en_US'.
- `currency` *(optional)*: Optional 3-letter currency code, e.g. 'USD'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/cruise?url_path=<url_path>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /cruise/reviews — 1-5cr

Returns a unified ReviewList of passenger reviews for a TripAdvisor cruise ship, keyed by its `url_path` (`entity_id` on every review). Each review carries the star rating, full text, title, reviewer profile with contribution count, attached photos, helpful-vote count, and the publish date. Get the `url_path` from /v1/tripadvisor/cruises. Note this lane carries no owner/management responses and no per-review permalink - both exist only on hotel and restaurant reviews. A ship with no reviews returns 404 (auto-refunded).

> ⚠️ **Metered: 1-5 credits a call — budget the 5 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 1-5 (metered): 1 credit per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.

**Parameters**

- `url_path`: The TripAdvisor cruise `url_path`, or a full TripAdvisor cruise URL.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of reviews to retrieve (default 20, max 40).
- `language` *(optional)*: Review language code, e.g. 'en'.
- `label` *(optional)*: Optional CSV of SocialCrawl labels to add to every review. Without this param every page already carries sentiment and issue, free; label= adds the labels you name to them (the defaults keep running). sentiment and issue are free when asked for too; reports, incentivized and injection add 1 credit per started 25 newly judged reviews. judgments=off (or label=none) turns the default labels off. They read the review's title and text, never its stars. sentiment: how the reviewer feels, on five levels (level 0 to 4, score_0_1, confidence), plus rating_mismatch, true when the words clearly contradict the star rating (a glowing text under 1 star, a furious one under 5), null when the review has no rating. issue: the main problem the review reports (label: product_defect, sizing_or_fit, shipping_or_delivery, customer_service, price_or_value, missing_feature, other, or none, with confidence; label is null when unsure). reports (needs reports=): does this review say that the thing you describe happened (p, 0 to 1). incentivized: does the reviewer say they got the product free, discounted or rewarded for the review (p), and did the text carry a disclosure such as 'in exchange for my honest review', Vine or 체험단 (disclosed). injection flags text that addresses an AI system and tries to direct it (flagged, p); it never drops or rewrites a row. These are signals to read, never a verdict on a review or a reviewer. A review that could not be judged carries labels: null. Reviews already labelled for anyone are free, and so is a cached page. data.labels reports what was judged and billed.
- `reports` *(optional)*: Required by label=reports, ignored otherwise. What to look for, in plain words, up to 300 characters, for example reports=the battery drains quickly or reports=배송이 늦음. Every review gains labels.reports.p, the probability that it says so, in any wording or language. Without it label=reports is skipped with the warning label_reports_needs_reports and is not billed.
- `judgments` *(optional)*: Optional, on (the default) or off. By default every row gains free SocialCrawl judgments (computed.labels, and computed.relevance on search endpoints), reported in data.labels (mode default) and data.relevance (origin default), each with a status (complete, partial or skipped) and pending: the rows still being judged when the page was sent, which carry null now and are filled on your next call or cached read. Default judgments never add credits, never change an existing field, and never drop or reorder a row. off returns the page exactly as before, with none of those keys. label=none does the same.
- `dry_run` *(optional)*: Optional. When 1, return a cost preview for this labelled or relevance-filtered request without fetching the page or judging any row. data.estimate reports rows_expected, rows_cached, label_credits_min, label_credits_max and base_credits. 0 credits charged.
- `label_evidence` *(optional)*: Optional, only with label=. When 1, every labelled row also carries computed.labels_evidence.<preset> = { quote, sentence_index }: the sentence in the row that most clearly shows the label, copied verbatim. Absent or null when no single sentence shows it.
- `fit` *(optional)*: Optional. When goal, keep the rows and fields needed for the goal you pass in goal= (plus any that are uncertain, and the first and last), and replace the rest with a stub. data.held_back lists the held ids and a recall id that re-reads the full page from cache at no extra charge. Without this param the page is unchanged.
- `goal` *(optional)*: Required by fit=goal. What you are trying to do, in your own words, up to 300 characters.
- `fit_tokens` *(optional)*: Optional, only with fit=goal. Soft cap on how much of the page to keep, in tokens. Uncertain blocks and the first and last block are kept even if they exceed it.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/cruise/reviews?url_path=<url_path>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a TripAdvisor endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Find a place or business | `/search` | 1 |
| Its reviews | `/reviews` | 1 |

Both 1 credit — the cheapest review source in the API. A full "what do people say about this
venue" answer costs 2 credits total.

Scope is hospitality and location-based business: hotels, restaurants, attractions. For a
local business that is not travel-shaped, `google/business/info` (1cr) and
`google/business/extended-reviews` (5cr) are the better fit.
